summary: Comprehensive testing of timezone-based karaoke auto-activation/deactivation and location timezone support. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend verified Las Vegas Social Wall shows correct PDT timezone and active karaoke.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Timezone and karaoke auto-activation features fully tested. Las Vegas (PDT) and Riverdale (EDT) have karaoke active on Thursday. Edgewood and Douglasville have karaoke on Wednesday so correctly inactive on Thursday.

las_vegas_active_thursday.test: Las Vegas karaoke (Thursday 20:00-02:00 PT) should be active on Thursday evening PT

riverdale_active_thursday.test: Riverdale karaoke (Thursday 20:00-02:00 ET) should be active on Thursday evening ET

douglasville_inactive_thursday.test: Douglasville karaoke (Wednesday) should be inactive on Thursday

edgewood_auto_deactivated.test: Edgewood karaoke (Wednesday) should be auto-deactivated on Thursday
